en: The shortest and lightest of all weapons. Weak, but it strikes fast.
A dagger home to a wind spirit. Raises the wielder's agility and magic.
The assassin's hidden weapon. Ordinary power, but prone to critical hits.
The finest dagger, worn on the wrist. Unpredictable power; awakens the wielder's gifts.
A fairly short, light sword. Don't expect much power from it.
A short sword of the great House of Chrysaor. More than just power: it has many virtues.
A short sword forged by a high mage, sealing the power of fire magic.
A short sword offered to Cassandra, beauty of old. Aids wielders who lack strength.
Antaria's most common weapon, steady in attack. With a shield, it balances offence and defence.
A sword for the charge: light, tough and keen. A hero's weapon.
A long sword of holy silver. Raises resistance to dark magic.
A long sword of the great House of Chrysaor, proud of its superior power.
A legendary sword forged by the ancient gods. Mighty power and many virtues.
Made by Lord Mogley, heretic of the House of Chrysaor. Stronger than a Chrysaor.
A legendary magic sword with the power of lightning sleeping within.
The emblem of the Granada trading company.
A practice sword for those in martial training.
A legendary magic sword with the power of ice sleeping within.
A long sword imbued with magic, made for magic knights.
A two-handed sword, broader and heavier than most. No shield can be used with it.
A magic sword imbued with dark magic. It numbs the foe's mind.
The beloved sword of Wiesbaden of the Sun, one of the Twelve Gods.
One of the Three Treasures of Pandragon. Great power, imbued with lightning.
The magic sword of the dark knights, forged in Gaysir.
The beloved sword of Baek Okdang.
A huge sword, broader and longer in the blade than a long sword. No shield.
The Chrysaor greatsword, prized and coveted by every warrior.
The sword of the brave.
The beloved sword of Shakbari, god of war.
The ultimate sword, born, legend says, of the power of Deimos, lord of the Thirteen Evil Gods.
A warrior's battle axe. It can strike a wide area.
A masterpiece of the House of Burova, master axe makers.
A battle axe for the charge.
A butcher's axe that kills in one blow.
A practice axe used by warriors in training.
A broad double-bladed axe. Stronger than a battle axe, and it helps in defence too.
A broad axe with reinforced power.
The broad axe favoured by Raevius of the Earth, one of the Twelve Gods.
A magic axe sealing the power of fire magic.
A huge, broad double-bladed axe. It takes great strength and skill to wield.
The finest masterpiece of the House of Burova of Dagal. A kind of great axe.
A magic axe sealing the power of lightning.
The axe of Karat of the Lightning, one of the Twelve Gods.
The common foot soldier's spear. It can strike foes at some distance.
A stronger version of the spear.
A masterpiece of Sansimir, the famous spear maker.
The practice spear used by the guards of Astania.
A spear for riders.
A kind of lance with mysterious hidden virtues.
A masterpiece of Xavir, the great lance makers.
A heavy, powerful weapon: a spear tipped with an axe blade.
A masterpiece of Sarisada, the great halberd makers.
A magic halberd imbued with dark magic. It has many virtues.
The huge halberd of the dragon knights. Strong attack and superb magic qualities.
Strikes from afar, but is weak in attack and defence.
Arrows fletched with eagle feathers for more piercing power.
A big, long bow. It can't shoot fast, but it hits hard.
A mechanism gives this bow more range and power.
A stronger crossbow that shoots many bolts at once.
A magic bow sealing powerful lightning magic.
The finest crossbow, made in Cutis.
A priest's striking weapon, with magical virtues too.
A stronger mace: both its power and its magic are improved.
One of the Three Treasures of Pandragon. It supports many magical effects.
A priest's striking weapon.
A mage's staff. Raises the wielder's magical abilities.
A fine staff for mages, with stronger magical virtues.
A kind of rod with especially strong fire magic.
A kind of rod with especially strong ice magic.
A kind of rod with especially strong lightning magic.
A kind of rod with especially strong dark magic.
A mage's wand with a special power to raise MP.
A round shield of wood.
A round shield of bronze.
A round shield of steel.
A round shield of dragon scales.
A knight's shield of wood.
A knight's shield of bronze.
A knight's shield of steel.
A knight's shield of dragon scales.
A tower shield of wood.
A tower shield of bronze.
A tower shield of steel.
A tower shield of dragon scales.
A shield protected by powerful magic. Good elemental affinity too.
A shield sealing the spirit of fire.
A shield sealing the spirit of ice.
A shield sealing the spirit of lightning.
Protects the wearer from fire attacks.
Protects the wearer from ice attacks.
Protects the wearer from lightning attacks.
Protects the wearer from dark magic.
A necklace made from a dragon's reverse scale. It has many effects.
A potion with many effects.
A mysterious magic stone.
One of the Three Treasures of Pandragon. It has many effects.
Lets the wearer act more often in battle.
Raises speed and defence.
A potion made from a dragon's tooth.
Protects the wearer from fire attacks.
Protects the wearer from ice attacks.
Protects the wearer from lightning attacks.
Protects the wearer from dark magic.
Raises the wearer's strength.
Raises the wearer's speed.
Raises the wearer's wisdom.
Raises the wearer's defence.
A mysterious cloak home to a wind spirit.
A crystal ball that raises magic power.
An orb used by dark mages.
A special orb sealing more power than an ordinary orb.
Reduces both physical and magical attacks.
A mysterious item of unknown effect.
